series.name: Legacy inverter S/E codes (S01-S07 sensors, E01-E13 drive/protection)
series.notes: Older Panasonic inverter models (S01-S07 sensor family, E01-E13 drive/protection) still found in the field. Legacy compile (dealer CDN PDF), medium. Separate series — digits collide with quarantined wired-remote E-family (E01-E09 different meanings) — never merged across generations.

meaning.en: The room air temperature sensor is not reporting a usable value.
meaning.ur: Room ka temperature sensor sahi reading nahi de raha.

causes.en: Room thermistor open/short or connector loose at the indoor PCB
causes.ur: Room thermistor open/short hai ya connector PCB pe dhila hai

causes.en: Damaged sensor lead (rodents, moisture, heat)
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire kharab hai (chooha/paani/garmi ki wajah se)

solutions.en: Reseat the sensor connector and measure the thermistor for continuity
solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein aur thermistor ki continuity check karein

solutions.en: Replace the sensor; if it still fails, check the indoor PCB
solutions.ur: Sensor badlein, phir bhi fail ho to indoor PCB check karein

meaning.en: The indoor heat exchanger sensor is not reporting a usable value.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil ka sensor sahi reading nahi de raha.

causes.en: Coil thermistor open/short or clip not touching the pipe
causes.ur: Coil thermistor open/short hai ya clip pipe se touch nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Connector loose on the indoor PCB
causes.ur: Indoor PCB pe connector dhila hai

solutions.en: Check sensor continuity and refit the clip on the pipe
solutions.ur: Sensor ki continuity check karein aur clip pipe pe theek se lagayein

solutions.en: Replace the sensor if continuity is missing
solutions.ur: Continuity na ho to sensor badlein

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ka communication fail

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units cannot exchange signals.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke beech signal exchange nahi ho raha.

causes.en: Inter-unit wiring loose, broken or wrongly landed
causes.ur: Inter-unit wire dhili, tooti ya galat lagi hui hai

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor PCB communication circuit faulty
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor PCB ka communication circuit kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and recheck the inter-unit cable and terminals
solutions.ur: Power band karke inter-unit cable aur terminals dobara check karein

solutions.en: Replace damaged cable; if the cable is fine, test both PCBs
solutions.ur: Wire kharab ho to badlein; wire theek ho to dono PCB test karein

meaning.en: The HIC power-driving stage for the compressor/fan reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Compressor aur fan ko chalane wale HIC power stage ne kharabi batayi hai.

causes.en: HIC/IGBT module or its gate drive faulty
causes.ur: HIC/IGBT module ya uska gate drive kharab hai

causes.en: Over-current/short in the motor circuit
causes.ur: Motor circuit mein over-current/short hai

solutions.en: Power off for 10 minutes and have the drive module tested
solutions.ur: 10 minute power off rakh ke drive module test karwayein

solutions.en: Check for shorted windings/cables before replacing the module
solutions.ur: Module badalne se pehle winding/cables mein short check karein

meaning.en: The outdoor unit's stored program/data could not be read.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ki stored program/data read nahi ho rahi.

causes.en: Outdoor PCB memory (OTP ROM) faulty
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ki memory (OTP ROM) kharab hai

causes.en: Corrupted program after a power interruption
causes.ur: Power cut ke baad program kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Cut power for a few minutes and restart to see if it re-reads
solutions.ur: Kuch minute power band karke restart karein, dobara read ho jaye to theek

solutions.en: Have the outdoor PCB repaired/replaced if the code stays
solutions.ur: Code rahe to outdoor PCB repair/replace karwayein

meaning.en: The 4-way reversing valve did not switch when commanded.

solutions.en: Replace the RV coil or valve if it does not shift
solutions.ur: RV coil ya valve badlein agar shift na ho

meaning.ur: Coil jamne wala tha, is liye anti-freeze control chalu ho gaya.

solutions.ur: Indoor filter saaf/badlein aur coil wash karein
